headline: PayLater Requires Salary of Rp3 Million, OJK Reveals This Fact
summary: OJK is tightening buy-now-pay-later (paylater) service rules, requiring borrowers to be at least 18 years old and earn at least Rp3 million per month. Effectiveness of the rule is questioned.
why: Buy-now-pay-later services are short-term consumer credit products, and regulatory limits on borrowers affect lending volumes and credit risk for providers.
original_headline: Paylater Wajib Bergaji Rp3 Juta, OJK Ungkap Fakta Ini
